factGroups.label: Package size and servings
factGroups.effect: Exempt only if more than 1 serving AND at least 2.5 oz; otherwise taxable. Candy is taxable at any size.

factGroups.label: Candy / confectionery
factGroups.effect: Candy classification makes the item taxable regardless of size or servings.

factGroups.label: Heating and utensils
factGroups.effect: Heating by the seller, or utensils from a non-bakery seller, turns an otherwise exempt food item taxable.

factGroups.label: Prepared vs. home cooking
factGroups.effect: Raw or frozen food for home cooking is exempt; cooked or served prepared food is taxable.

factGroups.label: Juice and sweetening
factGroups.effect: More than 50% juice is exempt; sweetened drinks at 50% or less are taxable soft drinks.

factGroups.label: FDA label type
factGroups.effect: A qualifying Drug Facts or Supplement Facts product is exempt; the same shelf category without it is taxable.

factGroups.label: Product type within a mixed subcategory
factGroups.effect: Exempt and taxable products sit in the same subcategory, so type, not category, decides.

factGroups.label: Live vs. recorded / deliverable
factGroups.effect: Several digital and service outcomes turn on delivery and rights; the workbook requires these rules approved before launch.

factGroups.label: Date-bound eligibility
factGroups.effect: Exempt only when the item, date and value requirements of the specific exemption are all met.

factGroups.label: Bundle itemisation
factGroups.effect: Itemised components are taxed line by line; an unitemised mixed bundle is blocked from publication.

facts.label: Net weight (oz)
facts.help: The net weight of one package in ounces, as printed on the label.

facts.label: Servings per package
facts.help: How many servings the label says one package holds.

facts.label: Sold as a single serving
facts.help: Yes if the package is one portion meant for one person at one time.

facts.label: Candy or confectionery
facts.help: Yes if this is candy, chocolate, gum or a sweet confection. Candy is taxed at any size.

facts.label: Coated or sugar-glazed
facts.help: Yes if the nuts or seeds are candy-coated, chocolate-covered, honey-glazed or otherwise confectionery.

facts.label: Sold hot or heated
facts.help: Yes if you serve or sell this warm, or warm it before the customer gets it.

facts.label: You heat it
facts.help: Yes if you (not the customer) do the heating.

facts.label: You provide eating utensils
facts.help: Yes if forks, spoons, straws or plates for eating it are included with the order.

facts.label: Your shop is a bakery
facts.help: Taken from your seller profile: yes if your business is a bakery.

facts.label: Sold as a prepared meal
facts.help: Yes if it is ready to eat as a meal (cooked and portioned), not raw or for cooking at home.

facts.label: Sold cooked and hot
facts.help: Yes if you sell it freshly cooked and hot.

facts.label: Fruit or vegetable juice content
facts.help: The percentage of real fruit or vegetable juice, as stated on the label.

facts.label: Sweetened
facts.help: Yes if sugar, syrup, honey or another sweetener is added.

facts.label: Classified as a soft drink
facts.help: Yes if it is a carbonated or sweetened drink in the soft-drink style (soda, sports or energy drink).

facts.label: Contains milk or a milk substitute
facts.help: Yes if milk, cream or a plant milk (oat, soy, almond...) is an ingredient.

facts.label: Label on the package
facts.help: The panel printed on the package: Drug Facts, Supplement Facts or Nutrition Facts.

facts.label: Qualifies as a labelled drug or supplement
facts.help: Yes only if the label is on the package and the product fits that label's definition. Our tax team checks this.

facts.label: Photo or PDF of the label
facts.help: Upload a clear picture of the whole label. It is kept as the proof for the exemption.

facts.label: Kind of hygiene product
facts.help: Pick what the product is.

choices.label: Soap, toothpaste or other non-medicated item

facts.label: Kind of device
facts.help: Pick what fits best. Prescribed or medically qualifying devices need proof.

facts.label: Proof the device qualifies
facts.help: Upload the product listing, FDA clearance or the prescription rule that shows it qualifies.

facts.label: Type of publication
facts.help: Pick what the publication is.

choices.label: Newspaper or other publication with a specific exemption

facts.label: Proof of the exemption
facts.help: Upload the page or notice that shows why it is exempt.

facts.label: What this product is
facts.help: Pick what the product is under its label.

facts.label: How the course is delivered
facts.help: Live classes taught by an instructor, or a recording or other digital deliverable.

choices.label: Recorded or a digital file or access

facts.label: How the customer gets it
facts.help: Download of a file, or online access only.

facts.label: Exemption confirmed by tax review
facts.help: Set only by our tax team after review. Sellers do not fill this in.

facts.label: What the buyer receives
facts.help: A file or artwork to keep, or only a personal service.

choices.label: A downloaded file, artwork or photo
A personal service with no file delivered

facts.label: What the customer gets
facts.help: Photos or prints and files to keep, or only the service.

facts.label: Kind of event
facts.help: Pick what fits the event. Exempt events need proof.

choices.label: Admission that is not taxable, or an exempt event

facts.label: Proof the event is exempt
facts.help: Upload the organiser's exemption letter or event details.

facts.label: Class or membership
facts.help: A class led by an instructor, or access to a gym or facility.

choices.label: Class or training led by an instructor

facts.label: Eligible for a tax holiday or special exemption
facts.help: Yes only if this item is listed for a legislated tax holiday or exemption. Our tax team checks this.

facts.label: Sale date inside an exemption window
facts.help: Worked out by the system from the sale date and the exemption calendar; never typed by a person.

facts.label: How the bundle is itemised
facts.help: Each item in a gift basket must be its own line with its own category and price.

choices.label: Exempt food, listed as its own line
Taxable goods, listed as their own line
Mixed items sold as one price, not itemised

facts.label: Gift card transaction
facts.help: Set by the order system: the sale of the card, or its use to buy a taxable or an exempt item.

choices.label: Used to buy a taxable item
Used to buy an exempt item
